Student Record Management Application Using SQLite

Framework: React Native (Expo + TypeScript) • Database: Local SQLite (expo-sqlite / students.db)

Objective: Develop a React Native mobile application that stores and manages student information (Add, View, Update, Delete) using a local SQLite database.

Live Deployed Mobile Web Application (Vercel)
https://studentrecordmanagementreactnative.vercel.app/
Status: Live & Verified

1. Requirements Checklist & SQLite Verification

Requirement Implementation Detail SQLite Query Executed Status
Add Student Enter student's Name, Course, and Age in StudentFormModal.tsx INSERT INTO students (name, course, age) VALUES (?, ?, ?); Completed
View Students Display all registered students & 4 KPI cards in HomeScreen.tsx SELECT id, name, course, age FROM students ORDER BY id DESC; Completed
Update Student Modify Name, Course, and Age of any existing student record UPDATE students SET name = ?, course = ?, age = ? WHERE id = ?; Completed
Delete Student Prompt confirmation dialog (DeleteConfirmModal.tsx) and remove record DELETE FROM students WHERE id = ?; Completed
Local Database Persist all student records locally using SQLite (students.db) in src/database/db.ts CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (...); Completed

2. Mobile Application Output Screenshots (Proof of Implementation)

1. Mobile View - Dashboard & 4 Multi-Theme KPI Summary Cards

Opening https://studentrecordmanagementreactnative.vercel.app/ on mobile displays the header, '+ Add Student' button, and the 4 SQLite KPI cards (Total List, Pending Review, Settled On-Site, Resolved & Synced).

2. View Students - Registered Student Directory (SQLite Records)

Scrolling down the mobile directory displays all pre-registered student records loaded from SQLite (students.db) with their dynamic color themes, course badges, and age pills.

3. Add Student - Entering Student Name, Course, and Age

Tapping '+ Add Student' opens the mobile Add New Student modal. Here we enter Name: 'Kristine Joy Bautista', Course: 'BS Cybersecurity', and Age: '21'.

4. Add Student - New Student Record Saved in SQLite

After tapping 'Save Student', INSERT INTO students executes and 'Kristine Joy Bautista' (ID #6) appears at the top of the mobile student directory.

Mobile Application Output Screenshots (Continued)

5. Update Student - Modifying an Existing Student Record

Tapping 'Update' on Joshua Villanueva (ID #5) opens the Update Student Record modal pre-filled with his data. We modify his Course to 'BS Data Science & AI (Honors)' and Age to '21'.

6. Update Student - Updated Information Persisted in SQLite

After tapping 'Update Record', UPDATE students SET ... WHERE id = 5 executes and Joshua Villanueva's card reflects his new course and age.

7. Delete Student - Mobile Confirmation Dialog Before Removal

Tapping 'Delete' on Angela Mae Reyes (ID #4) displays the confirmation dialog ('Delete Student Record') before permanently deleting the record from SQLite.

8. Delete Student - Record Removed from SQLite Directory

After tapping 'Confirm Delete', DELETE FROM students WHERE id = 4 executes and Angela Mae Reyes is removed from the mobile directory.
